components.name: Pill Tag Badge
components.description: Metadata tag for blog topics and status indicators.
components.css: .ds-badge-tag { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 2px 10px; border-radius: 9999px; background: oklch(92.5% 0.006 150deg); color: oklch(56% 0.02 150deg); font-family: 'Lilex', monospace; font-size: 0.875rem; border: 1px solid oklch(88% 0.005 150deg); text-decoration: none; transition: color 180ms ease, border-color 180ms ease; } .ds-badge-tag:hover { color: oklch(40% 0.03 150deg); border-color: oklch(42% 0.14 148deg); }

components.name: Primary Action Button
components.description: Primary action button with green forest/mint accent highlight.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 8px 16px; border-radius: 6px; background: oklch(45% 0.13 148deg); color: #fff; font-family: 'DM Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 0.9375rem; font-weight: 600; border: none; cursor: pointer; transition: opacity 180ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { opacity: 0.9; }

components.name: Continuous Wipe Text Link
components.description: Prose link with continuous underline wipe.
components.css: .ds-prose-link { color: oklch(40% 0.03 150deg); text-decoration: underline; text-decoration-color: oklch(56% 0.02 150deg); text-decoration-thickness: 1px; text-underline-offset: 3px; background-image: linear-gradient(oklch(42% 0.14 148deg), oklch(42% 0.14 148deg)); background-repeat: no-repeat; background-position: 0 100%; background-size: 0% 1.5px; transition: color 260ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1), background-size 260ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); } .ds-prose-link:hover { color: oklch(42% 0.14 148deg); text-decoration-color: transparent; background-size: 100% 1.5px; }

components.name: Technical Callout Box
components.description: Obsidian/directive style admonition box with green accent edge.
components.html:
Architectural Invariant

Leader election requires a strict majority quorum (N/2 + 1) to prevent split-brain states during network partitions.
components.css: .ds-callout { margin: 1.5rem 0; padding: 1rem 1.25rem; border-radius: 6px; background: oklch(92.5% 0.006 150deg); border: 1px solid oklch(88% 0.005 150deg); border-inline-start: 1px solid oklch(42% 0.14 148deg); } .ds-callout-title { font-family: 'DM Sans', sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.9375rem; color: oklch(40% 0.03 150deg); margin-bottom: 0.35rem; } .ds-callout-body { margin: 0; font-family: 'DM Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 0.9375rem; line-height: 1.6; color: oklch(56% 0.02 150deg); }

components.name: Expressive Code Block Header
components.description: Code snippet header bar with language badge and copy button.
components.css: .ds-code-header { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; padding: 6px 12px; background: oklch(92.5% 0.006 150deg); border: 1px solid oklch(88% 0.005 150deg); border-bottom: none; border-radius: 8px 8px 0 0; font-family: 'Lilex', monospace; font-size: 0.8125rem; color: oklch(56% 0.02 150deg); } .ds-code-lang { font-weight: 600; color: oklch(45% 0.13 148deg); } .ds-code-filename { opacity: 0.8; } .ds-code-copy { background: transparent; border: 1px solid oklch(88% 0.005 150deg); border-radius: 4px; padding: 2px 8px; font-size: 0.75rem; color: inherit; cursor: pointer; } .ds-code-copy:hover { color: oklch(40% 0.03 150deg); border-color: oklch(42% 0.14 148deg); }

narrative.overview: Scholar SWE Codex is an editorial, high-craft design system tailored for long-form engineering essays, systems postmortems, architecture dissections, and technical notebooks. Inspired by the calm digital-garden aesthetic of My Scholar and academic typography traditions, the interface is deliberately quiet and restrained, centered around an editorial green theme.
keyCharacteristics: Quiet Editorial Authority: Typography and whitespace take precedence over decorative containers.
Academic & Digital-Garden Hybrid: Rigorous typography paired with modern interactive affordances.
Editorial Green Palette: Pine, emerald, and mint accents grounded by calm sage-paper and deep pine midnight neutrals.
First-Class Technical Notation: Monospace code blocks, formulas, and diagrams integrated with equal care as body text.
Bilingual Typographic Harmony: Seamless visual balance across English and Traditional Chinese (CJK) letterforms.

rules.name: The Rarity Rule
rules.body: Primary and secondary accent colors (--primary and --accent) must occupy less than 5% of any viewport. Their restraint ensures that code highlights and prose remain the focal point.

rules.name: The Pure Black Prohibition
rules.body: Never use #000000 for backgrounds or #ffffff for pure white text in dark mode. Always use calibrated OKLCH neutral tokens to preserve reading comfort over prolonged sessions.

rules.name: The 44rem Measure Rule
rules.body: Running prose must never stretch beyond 44rem (704px). Wide viewports place balanced outer whitespace in the margins rather than stretching paragraph line length.

rules.name: The Continuous Underline Wipe
rules.body: Inline prose links have a subtle muted underline at rest. On hover, a solid accent stroke sweeps continuously from inline-start to inline-end (background-size: 0% to 100%). Under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce, this smoothly falls back to an instant color transition.

rules.name: The Shadowless Discipline
rules.body: No fuzzy multi-layer drop shadows. Surfaces declare depth exclusively through subtle background lightness deltas and razor-sharp 1px borders.

dos: Do maintain a strict 44rem (~704px) maximum measure for prose paragraphs to guarantee effortless readability.
Do test every code block, callout, and table in both light and dark modes to verify WCAG AAA contrast.
Do provide copy buttons on all code snippets and include syntax highlighting language tags.
Do use light-dark() with OKLCH colors for all color declarations.
Do ensure Chinese characters (Traditional Chinese) render with appropriate line-height (1.75+) and fall back gracefully through system CJK fonts.
donts: Don't use pure #000000 or #ffffff high-glare surfaces; always use the calibrated paper and midnight slate tokens.
Don't add decorative floating blob gradients, noisy background textures, or intrusive scrolling animations that distract from reading.
Don't allow lines of technical prose to stretch across wide 1440px+ viewports without constraining the container.
Don't wrap links in generic heavy buttons unless they trigger explicit state actions; use text links with the continuous underline wipe.
Don't ship code blocks without an easy one-click copy mechanism.
